新增后，用户、角色、部门等数据变动时会推送到你填写的地址: Once added, changes to users, roles, departments and more are pushed to your address

请填写正确的地址（http:// 或 https://）: Enter a valid URL (http:// or https://)
请至少订阅一个事件: Subscribe to at least one event
停用后不再推送新事件，排队中的重试也会停止: When off, no new events are sent and queued retries stop
把签名密钥配置到接收方，用来确认请求来自本系统。之后可以在「签名密钥」里再次查看: Configure the signing secret on the receiver to confirm requests come from this system. You can view it again under "Signing secret" (identity check required).
验证方法：用密钥对「X-Castor-Timestamp 的值、英文句点、原始请: To verify: compute HMAC-SHA256 with the secret over the X-Castor-Timestamp value, a period and the raw request body joined together; it must equal the part after sha256= in X-Castor-Signature.
